note: Who may approve a decision record, and the rule that applies. Read by scripts/check-decision-records.py: an approval rule the registry cannot satisfy is refused, so the process page can never demand two approvers from a project that has one (IC-663, tests 1281-1282). Appointment, inactivity and removal are recorded here with a date and a reason, never by silently editing the list.

maintainers.name: Yashraj Pardeshi
maintainers.appointed_by: founding; the first record in docs/adr is dated 2026-05-04

founder_stage.condition: fewer active maintainers on this registry than required_approvals
founder_stage.rule: The one accountable maintainer records their own review in the pull request: what was checked, what alternatives were weighed, and why it merges. The two-approval rule resumes the day a second active maintainer is registered here; nothing else switches it back on.
founder_stage.ends_when: a second entry in maintainers with active true
